The '''Kintan Gunrunners''' were a group of primarily [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] weapons [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. They had a reputation for cruelty and murderous folly, and were known throughout [[Hutt Space]] and the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Tessent" />

At one point, a group of the Kintan Gunrunners were hiding out in the wastes of the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarafur]], primarily the [[Krasho Salt Rifts]]. They were rivals of a band of [[Thonner/Legends|Thonner]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Korraj]].<ref name="Tessent" />

The [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|red Nikto]] [[Tu'rsc'yulir]] was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the Kintan Gunrunners. Members of the organization were mainly of the Nikto [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]], but also included other species well-suited to the desert environment of Sarafur, such as [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]], [[Kamarian]]s and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]]. The [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] [[Maygo/Legends|"Plug-Eye" Maygo]] was a member of the group.<ref name="Tessent" />

The Kintan Gunrunners operated a [[Predator-class gunship|''Predator''-class gunship]], a smaller [[Lantillian cruiser]], and a quintet of [[Z-'ceptor]]s in poor shape. They also possessed a number of [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|Bantha-II cargo skiffs]] and the hulking [[Kintan strider/Legends|Kintan strider]] [[Kar'sylic]] among their ranks.<ref name="Tessent" />
